_comment: Copy to config.json (or select another path with ANDROIDLAB_CONFIG). This file configures database and skill_dir only; configure LLMs and other settings through environment variables or the application. For Gemini, choose gemini in System > LLM and enter an available model ID and API key.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. ANDROIDLAB_PG_DSN overrides this database section. Choose either (A) individual fields below or (B) a complete database.dsn connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Option B: replace the database section above with a complete DSN. A nonempty dsn overrides individual fields.
_comment_skill_dir: Skills root (one subdirectory per skill containing SKILL.md). Priority: ANDROIDLAB_SKILL_DIR > this field > skills/ beside the executable. Leave blank or omit to use the default. Relative paths resolve from the current working directory.
